verdict.rationale: Fireflies has its own documented GraphQL API with bearer-token (API key) authentication. It supports non-interactive automation such as uploading audio for transcription, querying transcripts, and receiving webhook callbacks when transcription completes, so it can be driven headlessly without the UI. However, there is no documented CLI, CI integration, or headless/CI-specific guidance, and API key setup is a manual dashboard step. missing for 10: official CLI or CI tooling, documented CI/headless usage patterns, service-account or non-interactive credential provisioning, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
